structured_output.summary: SharedDataMiddleware now serves files through send_file, so conditional (304/412) and range (206/416) requests work. HTTPException from send_file is returned as the WSGI response. cache_timeout defaults to None. cache and fallback_mimetype now default to None and emit DeprecationWarning when passed. cache=False still disables conditional handling and the ETag, and fallback_mimetype is still honoured. I couldn't run anything here, so none of the new tests have been run or checked against the base commit. generate_etag is left in place but is no longer called. I added tests in tests/middleware/test_shared_data.py for every new branch.

criteria_notes.note: Covered by test_no_default_cache_timeout (no max-age or Expires, ETag/Last-Modified/Accept-Ranges present), test_cache_timeout, test_conditional_304, test_precondition_failed, test_range (206 with Content-Range) and test_range_not_satisfiable (416). None of these have been run.

test_cache_false_deprecated and test_fallback_mimetype_deprecated_and_used both use pytest.deprecated_call. test_default_fallback_mimetype covers the no-warning default path. None of these have been run.
